title: A longer oxygenated chain
hook: Inspect the bonds and identify the functional group.

knows: Lines in a structural formula represent chemical bonds.
doesNotKnow: Ethanol has an O–H hydroxyl group attached to a saturated carbon, so its characteristic group is an alcohol.

misconception: Every molecule with the same element contains the same functional group.
objective: Recognize the stated functional group from condensed structural connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structure and explanation: Which listed functional group best describes the distinctive group in this condensed structural diagram? This diagram represents ethanol. Ethanol has an O–H hydroxyl group attached to a saturated carbon, so its characteristic group is an alcohol. Lines show bonds; grouped labels such as CH₃ are condensed notation.
The diagram is a condensed 2D structural representation, not a model of molecular geometry.
Recall: Which group is illustrated in the ethanol example? Ethanol has an O–H hydroxyl group attached to a saturated carbon, so its characteristic group is an alcohol.
